node.title: Integer shifted-core masses give a two-level compression envelope
node.statement: For ACTUAL compression fibre INTEGER masses x_c in[L,Z], 1<=L<=Z<=S and sum x_c<=S, let w(x) bound nonpreferred original raw weight. If T>=L,H>=0 are integers with(H+1)(T+1)>S and alpha,beta>=0 satisfy w(x)<=alpha*x below/equal T and <=alpha*x+beta above T, total raw weight<=t+alpha*S+H*beta. The common preferred slope is charged once. For S1048577,T349525,H2 at most two fibres are large. This is a proved counting corollary, not a scalar LIST or Prize conclusion.
